candidates.computation_change_reason: Identifies which parameters are governed by site-specific criteria rather than default criteria; different interpretation of scope or approval status would change which numeric limits are enforceable for those metals.

candidates.exact_span: For industrial and federal facility, use the highest monthly average flow for the past 24 months. For POTWs, use the design flow.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Flow magnitude is an input to WQBEL derivation; treating the facility as industrial/federal versus POTW, or selecting a different flow statistic or period, would change calculated limits (A) and could change whether 24-month flow evidence is treated as a required monitoring/data obligation (B).

candidates.exact_span: Are acute aquatic life criteria considered (1= yes, 0= no)        (MUST enter "1" for 2005 Standards)             1
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether acute aquatic life criteria are included in the calculation toggles which criterion values enter limit derivation; a different yes/no reading would change applicable numeric limits.

candidates.exact_span: Are chronic aquatic life criteria considered (1= yes, 0=no)                                                       1
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether chronic aquatic life criteria are applied determines which chronic limits are computed and thus which limits are available for compliance comparison.

candidates.exact_span: Are domestic water supply criteria considered (1= yes, 0=no)                                                      0
candidates.computation_change_reason: Inclusion or exclusion of domestic water supply criteria changes whether domestic-supply-based numeric limits are generated and enforceable.

candidates.exact_span: Are irrigation water supply criteria considered (1= yes, 0=no)                                                    0
candidates.computation_change_reason: Inclusion or exclusion of irrigation water supply criteria changes whether irrigation-based numeric limits are part of the applicable limit set.

candidates.exact_span: Livestock watering and wildlife habitat criteria applied to all streams
candidates.computation_change_reason: States that additional use-class criteria are always applied; different interpretation of applicability or scope would add or remove criteria used in limit calculations.

candidates.exact_span: Is a publicly owned lake or reservoir (enter "1" if it's a lake, "0" if not)                                      0
candidates.computation_change_reason: Lake/reservoir classification selects different receiving-water calculation pathways; misreading the flag would change derived effluent limits.

candidates.exact_span: For intermittent stream, enter effluent TSS use 30
candidates.computation_change_reason: Specifies the receiving-stream TSS surrogate for intermittent streams; a different stream-classification or surrogate value would alter dilution and resulting WQBELs.

candidates.exact_span: For intermittent stream, enter effluent Hardness (If no data, 20 mg/l is used)
candidates.computation_change_reason: Hardness drives metal criteria translation; interpreting whether effluent hardness, receiving hardness, or the 20 mg/l default applies would change numeric limits (A) and how missing hardness evidence is classified versus imputed (C).

candidates.exact_span: Enter "0" for intermittent stream and lake.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Critical low flow (4Q3) is a mixing-model input; treating the receiving water as intermittent/lake versus perennial changes the flow value used and therefore calculated limits.

candidates.exact_span: Enter harmonic mean or modified harmonic mean flow data or 0.001 if no data is available
candidates.computation_change_reason: Harmonic mean flow affects dilution-based limit calculations; choosing measured harmonic mean versus the 0.001 default changes limits (A) and affects whether absent flow data is treated as documented no-data with a prescribed substitute or unresolved (C).

candidates.exact_span: Enter 1, if stream morphology data is not available or for intermittent streams.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The mixing-zone fraction F directly scales allowable pollutant mass; different interpretation of morphology availability or intermittent-stream status changes F and thus numeric limits.
